en.headline: Tow truck overturns in Lion Rock Tunnel forcing single-tube traffic
en.dek: A recovery vehicle rolled onto its side in the Kowloon-bound tube around 11:24 am on Monday after striking a barrier, slightly injuring the driver and causing heavy congestion under one-tube two-way running.
body: Police received a report from tunnel staff at about 11:24 am on Monday that a tow truck travelling towards Kowloon in the Lion Rock Tunnel had lost control, struck the concrete barrier and overturned across the carriageway.

A man in his forties suffered minor injuries to his hands and legs and declined to be taken to hospital, according to reports. Photographs circulating online showed the vehicle lying on its side with several metres of the kerb damaged.

The Transport Department said one-tube two-way traffic remained in force at the tunnel while clearance work continued, leading to congestion. Motorists were advised to consider the Tsing Sha Highway or Tate’s Cairn Tunnel as alternatives.
Officers remained at the scene to investigate the cause of the single-vehicle incident.

zh.headline: 獅子山隧道往九龍方向拖車翻側 實施單管雙程行車
zh.dek: 周一上午約11時24分，一輛拖車在獅子山隧道往九龍方向管道內疑失控撞石壆後翻側，司機輕傷拒送院，運輸署實施單管雙程行車，交通擠塞。
body: 警方接獲隧道職員報案，指周一上午約11時24分，一輛拖車沿獅子山隧道往九龍方向行駛時，在管道內懷疑失控，撞向路邊石壆後翻側橫亘車道。
據報一名四十多歲男子手腳受輕傷，經檢查後拒絕送院。網上圖片顯示車輛翻側在路中，石壆有數米損毀。
運輸署表示，因應交通意外，獅子山隧道仍實施單管雙程行車安排，現場交通擠塞。當局呼籲駕駛人士考慮改用青沙公路或大老山隧道。
警方留在現場調查事故成因。
